compliance.environment: Indoor use only, in environmentally controlled areas

physical.material: Steel and aluminum with plastic T-shaped cable guides and plastic accessories

base.description: The manager as Chatsworth ships 32623-E03, doors fitted, without accessories.

description: Motive double-sided vertical cable manager, Chatsworth Products 32623-E03. It is a Glacier White steel and aluminum manager, 7 ft (2134 mm) tall and 12 in (300 mm) wide, with black fingers. It bolts to the side of the rack and stands beside it. Two channels stand back to back about a central track. Each has a T-shaped cable guide to every rack unit down both sides and a dual-hinged door. The overall depth is 23.6 in (600 mm). It takes no rack unit.

name: 32623-e03

attrs.note: datasheet - material, finish and the indoor-only statement are the specifications table (page 1): 'Steel and aluminum with plastic T-shaped cable guides and plastic accessories', 'Black or Glacier White powder coat paint'. The matrix (page 3) gives the colour of this part and its black fingers.

bottom.note: estimated - the bottom end is the top end again.

chassis.note: estimated - 300 mm wide, 2133.6 mm (7 ft, 84 in) high and 600 mm deep. THE DEPTH IS THE DATA SHEET'S (matrix note, page 3: 'Overall depth for Double-Sided manager is 23.6"D (600 mm)'); THE WIDTH AND THE HEIGHT ARE NOMINAL (matrix, page 3: 12" (300) and 7' (2.1)), taken here as the overall size, which the matrix does not say they are. The section is therefore estimated as a whole, and the figure of each dimension is in the entry that uses it.

color.note: estimated - 'Glacier White' (matrix, page 3); the shade is the near-white of the data sheet's photographs of the fitted part, which are renders. The guides are black on every part number of this style.

door.note: estimated - the data sheet (page 1) lists a dual-hinged front door and a rear door assembly, pre-installed, and the installation instructions (page 3) draw the rear door as one plate; that the doors exist is printed, but no page prints a size of a door, so each is drawn as one plate of the manager's nominal width and height (the door components carry the method). A door opens to the right or to the left and lifts off; the format has no hinge, so the side is a gap. The front door has a latch tip at each edge and, on the 12 in width, two seams and a plate. The rear door is its own plain part with a latch tip at each edge. Each door has two latches on its inner face. On the side faces only the end of each handle shows, because the housing stands behind the arms. Each door component carries its figures.

fingers.note: estimated - A GUIDE TO EACH RACK UNIT, 48 A SIDE ON EACH FACE, 192 IN ALL. The data sheet (page 1) says the side assemblies carry T-shaped cable guides 'that align with rack-mount unit (U) spaces on rack'; no page counts them. 48 is the nominal 84 in over 1.75 in, a column from the foot to the top of the manager. A guide is an arm 12 high with a head 30 high and 20 wide, read by eye from the page 1 photographs and taken to be the same on every width and on both faces.

front.note: estimated - the front channel with its door fitted. With the door off the front is the channel between the two side assemblies, the heads of the guides down each edge and the central track between them. The channel is 260 wide, the nominal 300 less a side assembly of 20 each side, which is an estimate.

guides.note: estimated - the duct on each face is the channel between the two side assemblies, 260 wide, run down the height (`run: y`). Its finger pitch is the rack unit, 44.45; the gap between arms is the pitch less the arm's estimated 12.

left.note: estimated - the side, rear at x=0: 48 arms and heads at one rack unit on each face and a door at each end. The side is open between the arms and across the centre, as the data sheet's photographs show a side of slots. Each door's latch stands on the door's inner face. The housing is 15 x 70.5 mm, 4.7 to 1, the proportion of the page 3 figure's housing. That housing is 18 x 85.5 px at 300 dpi. At the figure's 1.380 mm per px it is about 25 x 118 mm. The built size is a stand-in. The arms and heads stand in front of the housing. Only about 14 mm of each 45 mm handle shows, between two heads.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE DATA SHEET'S ORDERING MATRIX; THE CONSTRUCTION FROM ITS TEXT AND THE INSTALLATION DRAWINGS. The Motive Cable Management data sheet (MKT-60020-675, 09/24) (page 3) builds the part number 32623-E03 from a style (2, double-sided, black fingers), a width (12 in, 300 mm), a colour (Glacier White) and a height (7 ft), and prints one overall depth for a double-sided manager, 23.6 in (600 mm). THE WIDTH AND THE HEIGHT ARE NOMINAL: the matrix prints them as sizes to order by, not as overall dimensions, and the figures here are taken as the overall size. The page 1 specifications and the installation instructions (IIS-737610) say what the manager is made of and how it is mounted and fitted with its doors. NO HELD PAGE DIMENSIONS THE PART INTERNALLY: a guide, a side assembly, the track, the centre section and the door are estimated, each in its own entry below. Nothing was copied from a picture; the figures are transcribed.

mount.note: drawing - rack-side. The installation instructions (page 2) have the manager positioned next to the rack and attached with 4 M8 carriage bolts, washers and flange nuts at the upper and lower pairs of holes, and draw the double-sided manager with the mounting holes of a 3 in and a 6 in wide rack in its centre section, so it stands beside the rack, outside the rails, a face to the front and a face to the rear. It occupies no rack unit; `ru: 48` is the 7 ft height over one rack unit and is estimated, because no held page says which racks a Motive height is for. The page 2 text says the manager is biased towards the rear on a 3 in wide rack; the model is drawn equal about its centre.

rear.note: estimated - the rear channel with its door fitted. The data sheet (page 1) lists a dual-hinged front door and rear door assembly, and the installation instructions (page 3) say the rear door is a plain flat door. No page draws the rear guides; the installation instructions' page 2 figure draws guides on both sides of the centre section and the rear is taken to be the front again, 48 a side.

right.note: estimated - the left view mirrored: the manager is the same on both sides. The rear end is on the right in this view. The rear latch and the rear guides stand there, and the front ones stand at the left.

shell.note: drawing - a hollow manager, as every manager in the library is. The body is a sheet body and its views are elevations; the solid is what its parts build: a frame and the guides on each face, and the two doors that lift off.

spine.note: estimated - the centre section, 198 deep between the two channels, with the central track and the mounting holes for the rack (installation instructions, page 2). The page 2 figure draws the rear guides, the centre and the front guides about equal in depth, so each is a third of the overall depth less the doors. The figure is not to a stated scale. The data sheet (page 6) sells a Mid Panel Kit that 'covers and divides the front and rear', so none is fitted: the centre is open in the side views.

thickness.note: estimated - no held page states a wall gauge. 1.5 is the plate of comparable parts in the library; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: estimated - the end of the manager seen from above, rear at y=0: a door 3 thick at each end, a channel of 198 at each, and the centre section of 198 between. The 600 is the data sheet's; the split is the estimate of the centre section, the guide and the frame.

guides.source: Motive data sheet page 1 (guides align with rack units) and page 3 (nominal width); the channel and the gap are the width less an estimated side assembly and the pitch less an estimated arm
